conditional_sampling_diagnostic.scope: Approximate design-based interval for the mean of this fixed synthetic population under its specified within-stratum sampling scheme. It is not a customer-population or model-parameter interval.

wilson_scope: Numerical reconciliation only. Rates of the fully generated synthetic population are known exactly. These intervals are not field estimates; heterogeneous generated probabilities also differ from a common-probability iid Bernoulli assumption.

cost_interval_diagnostic.scope: Only conditional technician-time sampling uncertainty; assumed rates and generated support hours held fixed. Not a forecast, financial statement or savings interval.

provenance_limits: All language probabilities, duration multipliers, domains and family assignments are coded assumptions; differences are not causal evidence.
The final generator has no technician, asset, site, date, PII or CRM identifiers. Added SYN-Q values are fabricated row labels, not pseudonymized identities.
The 15 grouped strata are a simulation taxonomy with no demonstrated mapping to actual 25 topics or 15 models.
The 375-cell empty-strata criticism assumes every topic/model combination is relevant and nonempty; the scenario alone does not establish that.
US/reference and lower-rate inputs are unverified assumptions, not verified BLS or regional-wage benchmarks.
Languages do not establish worker countries, regional wage weights or geography.
Generated support rows are not a CRM census. All counts and figures remain simulation results.
Four-decimal means are rounded displays; full-precision values drive arithmetic. No measured savings, margin, downtime, industrial safety or product benefit is established.
Distinct technician and support labor owners are reported separately; adding them does not make one company P&L cost.
